name: Momentum acceleration burst (ADX-confirmed)
rationale: Acceleration bet: a strong, FRESH short-lookback run-up (ret_Nd over a short window, strictly positive past a floor) tends to CONTINUE for several more days when a directional trend regime is already established (adx above a floor). The short lookback isolates the recent burst rather than slow trend, and the adx gate filters out chop where a sharp move is noise that mean-reverts. Distinct from a vanilla ADX trend-follow by forcing a short window AND a strictly-positive momentum floor: it buys acceleration, not mere trend membership.
catalyst: A sharp multi-day acceleration in price while the trend regime is already strong - momentum continuation before the burst is fully priced.
